description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105) capped at 19999, removes KO [Raise: 100%] capped at 19999, grants [Haste], [Last Stand], [Regenga], [High Quick Cast 2] and [Natural Cure: Rosa] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Rosa] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Rosa
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for White Magic or Support abilities, White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Rosa after using a White Magic or Support ability, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Pray+
description.text: Restores HP (20), restores 1 consumed ability use every fourth activation

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Natural Cure: Rosa
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (6000)] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
